facts.text: The user API is ten module-level functions, not a class
The module imports prologixGPIBUSB as the GPIB transport and Error from errors
The module uses Python 2 print statements
open_connection sets the GPIB address to 24 and clears the selected device
open_connection checks the *IDN? reply for 'KEITHLEY INSTRUMENTS INC.,MODEL 2400' and writes OUTP ON
current_mode writes SOUR:FUNC VOLT, SOUR:VOLT 0, CONF:CURR and FORM:ELEM CURR
voltage_mode writes SOUR:FUNC CURR, SOUR:CURR 0, CONF:VOLT and FORM:ELEM VOLT
resistance_mode writes CONF:RES and FORM:ELEM RES
read writes ARM:COUN 1, TRIG:COUN samples, TRIG:DEL interval and READ?
For more than one sample the allowed intervals are 0, 1, 10, 60, 600 and 3600 s; for one sample the interval is 0 through 99 s; samples is 1 to 100
set_voltage_source writes SOUR:VOLT followed by the value and warns that the source has a maximum resolution of 5 uV
A read of one sample returns one value; with more than one sample it returns Time and Data lists
enable_live_readings writes ARM:COUN INF, TRIG:DEL 0 and INIT
The upstream README calls the project a Python module for controlling a Keithley 2400 source-measure unit and says it depends on prologixGPIBUSB

operator_required.reason: the clone writes SOUR:VOLT with any value and states only a 5 uV resolution (keithley2400.py:152-156); it states no minimum or maximum voltage, so the operator must supply the source-voltage envelope
